#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
typedef pair<ll,ll> pii;

const long double EPS = 1e-15L;
const ll INF = 1000000007;

ll n, x, y;
long double best = INF;
pii ans;

void update(ll b, ll a) {
    long double diff = abs(1. * a / b - 1. * x / y);
    if (diff + EPS < best) {
        best = diff;
        ans = make_pair(b, a);
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    cin >> x >> y >> n;
    for (ll b = 1; b <= n; ++b) {
        ll a = x * b / y;
        update(b, a);
        update(b, a + 1);
    }
    cout << ans.second << '/' << ans.first;
    return 0;
}
